title: 'Cyborg 009: Nemesis' Reveals Additional Staff, Main Promo, Ending Theme
content: The official website of the Cyborg 009: Nemesis anime series revealed additional staff, a key visual (pictured), ending theme, and the main promo on Thursday. The anime adapting Shoutarou Ishinomori 's action sci-fi manga will begin streaming on July 19.

title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Casts Yūki Yoda, Naohito Fujiki
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga announced two more cast members for the film on Thursday.

title: Arc System Works Announces Qliphah in Providence's Shadow Game
content: Arc System Works announced the new Qliphah in Providence's Shadow game during the " ARC SYSTEM WORKS Showcase 2026 - June 24th" livestream on Wednesday. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on September 24.

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime's Main Trailer Unveils Sukima Switch's Ending Theme Song
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, started streaming on Thursday the anime's main promotional video, which reveals and previews the ending theme song "Climal" by Sukima Switch .
author: ANN

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film's Teaser Confirms Delay to January 8
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga unveiled a new teaser trailer and visual for the film on Thursday. The teaser confirms the film's new January 8, 2027 opening date, a delay from the film's originally planned fall 2026 opening.
author: ANN

title: Mikase Hayashi's Soredemo Otōto wa Koishitagaru Manga Gets Special Epilogue Chapter
content: The manga centers on two step-siblings: an older sister named Nao and her younger brother Rihito. Nao wants her little brother to depend on her more, but something seems to be lacking. The manga recently ended on May 22. Hayashi launched the manga in LaLa in February 2022.
author: ANN

title: Hiro Fujiwara's Maid-sama! Manga Gets Special Chapter
content: Fujiwara published a special chapter for the series in Hakusensha 's LaLa DX magazine in February 2025. Fujiwara launched the Maid Sama! manga in LaLa in 2006, and ended it in 2013. Hakusensha published 18 compiled book volumes for the manga, along with a new volume in August 2018.
author: ANN
